key_policy: rows are matched to engine output on the fixture keys (person_id is the fixture identity; the harness tokenises it with the fixture's person key); index_date/index_key identify the episode and are not released columns
invariants: dense: one row per episode and calendar month in [index-92, index+59] intersected with the covering period (1002: January and February only)
available source without rows at the whole site (bmi): count 0, last NA, carry NA on every row
two-identity source (vitals): per-concept columns, concepts never pooled (A-3)
carry-forward = value at the period start: last non-missing value dated <= period start and >= period start - 180 days
